name: cli-anything-ljg-ppt-design
description: PPT design system — 4 design presets (academic/consultant/business/tech) × 12 layouts × 4 talk types (conference/business/defense/school) × 5-dim quality review. Outputs DeckSpec JSON; renders to .pptx via python-pptx (default) or HKUDS LibreOffice backend. Lighter than cli-anything-libreoffice (no LibreOffice required). Source: yb2460/harness-anything (WPS section design system) + ljg platform-neutral refactor.
requires: Python >= 3.10; python-pptx (default); LibreOffice + HKUDS cli-anything-libreoffice (optional, for cross-platform rendering)
notes: Source design system originated in yb2460/harness-anything WPS module (4 preset × 12 layout × 4 talk type). ljg-ppt-design refactored to be platform-neutral (semantic colors → consumed by any renderer). Quality review thresholds follow slide-excellence (visual 70 / pedagogy 75 / proofreading 80 / parity 85 / substance 90).
